title: Autumn at My Table: Green Bean, Potato & Tofu Skillet

slides.alt: A red-orange pumpkin, a basket of bread rolls and a hammered metal pan of roasted pumpkin seeds on a leaf-patterned tablecloth, with the text "When autumn comes to my table, I don't shrink in fear."

A blue and white fish-patterned plate of green bean, potato and tofu stew on a woven mat, next to a Staub pan with more stew, with the text "I invite her to sit down, it's been a while. She must be tired."

A white bowl of green beans and potatoes in tomato sauce on a leaf-patterned tablecloth, with a pan of pumpkin seeds and a pumpkin in the background, with the text "She offers me her gifts, pumpkins and pumpkin seeds. And ripe apples and freshly preserved pickles."
A black skillet of green beans, potatoes and tofu cubes with a wooden spoon, with the text "I take a clean plate from the cupboard."

From above, a blue and white plate of green bean, potato and tofu stew, a small white dish of pickled gherkins and a Staub pan of stew, with the text "And as she sits there drawing her breath, I fill her plate, it's time she reaped what she has sown."
